title: Tests for show_default with non-string defaults
prompt: The help output for an option with `show_default=True` treats an empty-string default specially. That check must only apply to real strings: a default value whose type compares equal to `""` without being a string must be rendered normally. The code already handles this. Add tests to `tests/test_options.py` that cover this behaviour, so that they would catch a regression.
